prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
Sorry to hear you were in a crash — I can help. First, a few quick questions so I can give more specific guidance:
- When did the accident happen?
- Were you injured (hospitalized, seen in ER, or treated later)?
- Is fault disputed or is the other driver’s insurer accepting responsibility?
- Do you already have an insurer contact, claim number, or police report?
- Do you want a local Pleasanton recommendation, or general guidance on how to choose?

Immediate legal and medical steps (do these now if you haven’t):
- Seek medical care and keep records (hospital notes, doctor visits, scans).
- Get a copy of the police report and preserve photos of vehicles, scene, injuries.
- Collect witness names/contact info.
- Don’t sign release agreements or accept the insurer’s first “fast” settlement without advice.
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other side’s insurer without a lawyer.
- Preserve your car and other physical evidence.
- Be aware of deadlines: normal personal-injury statute of limitations in CA is 2 years from the accident; claims against government entities may have much shorter deadlines (often 6 months).

How to choose the right lawyer
Look for these qualities, not just a big ad:
- Focus: handles car accidents/personal injury regularly.
- Experience: track record with cases like yours (seat-belt injuries, TBI, soft tissue, wrongful death, uninsured motorist, etc.).
- Trial readiness: many cases settle, but choose a lawyer who will try the case if needed.
- Fees: most personal-injury lawyers work on contingency (commonly 33–40% + costs). Make sure fee structure and costs are clear in writing.
- Communication: who will you talk to (attorney vs. paralegal), typical response time?
- Resources: firm can advance costs for medical records, expert witnesses, etc.
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Alameda County courts, local judges, and medical providers is a plus.
- Clean disciplinary record (verify on the California State Bar website).

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- Have you handled many Pleasanton/Alameda County car-accident cases like mine?
- What was the outcome/value range for similar cases?
- Who will handle my case and how often will I be updated?
- What’s your fee and who pays costs if we don’t recover?
- How long do you expect my case to take?
- Do you have trial experience and references from past clients?

What to bring to consultations
- Police report number/copy
- Photos of the scene and injuries
- Medical records and bills or a list of providers/appointments
- Insurance information (yours and other drivers’)
- Any correspondence from insurers
- Names/contact of witnesses

Where to find attorneys
- California State Bar Lawyer Referral Service (and check Bar records)
- Local Alameda County or Tri-Valley bar associations
- Referral from friends/family
- Online directories and reviews (read recent client reviews and outcomes)

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific monetary amount
- Pressure to sign immediately
- No written fee agreement or unclear costs
- Poor communication during the initial consult

If you want, I can:
- Draft a short phone/email script to contact attorneys,
- Create a checklist of documents to bring to consultations,
- Or prepare a short list of Pleasanton-area personal-injury firms if you tell me your ZIP code and whether you want larger or boutique firms.
